thread:
Lina (oncall): paging - observation: a subset of enterprise customers in EU are seeing 502s from the /v1/generate endpoint since ~10:03 UTC. errors spike aligns with a routing config change. investigating.
Raj (infra): I’m on it. seeing increased 502 count and connection timeouts from edge -> serving. rolling back the routing change now.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-47. Severity: P1. Pagerduty alert sent to infra-oncall and eng-sre.
Lina (oncall): Vera, heads-up: CS will need a tailored outbound for impacted enterprise customers. list incoming in a minute.
Vera (cs): copy. I'll draft messaging templates once we confirm impact window and mitigation. who owns contact routing? Sam?
Sam (support): I can run contact routing. Please supply the account list + severity language and desired recipients (technical contact + exec sponsor).
Raj (infra): rollback in progress. telemetry shows 80% reduction in error rate after rollback start at 10:12 UTC. still seeing some residual 502s for long-tail requests.
Matt (product): Prioritize enterprise customers with reserved capacity (Dedicated) and Private deployments with SSO that might be affected differently. We need to call out possible token refresh issues as a secondary cause.
Lina (oncall): Drafted quick impact summary for status page (short): "Partial outage affecting text generation for a subset of EU enterprise customers; intermittent 502 errors observed; root cause: recent routing configuration change; mitigation: rollback in progress; restoring service to most customers."
